visitor.title: Vrmac for visitors
visitor.lead: One map and five ways in: explore the approved places and providers, follow the trails, ask a question that is answered only from validated sources, plan a day across the villages, and see what is coming up in the heritage calendar.
visitor.territory: The territory is the rural plateau of Vrmac, on both sides of the ridge. Every village here belongs to the municipality of Tivat or the municipality of Kotor.
visitor.honesty: A prototype built for an application, with sample data. It is not in production, it has no real users, and it claims no technology-readiness level. Only what a validator has approved ever appears here.
visitor.map.label: Map of the approved places, providers and trails
visitor.map.coordsNote: Coordinates are approximate until the places and trails are surveyed on the ground. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
visitor.map.baseOsm: Base map: OpenStreetMap raster tiles drawn with MapLibre GL. © OpenStreetMap contributors.
visitor.map.googleNoKey: No Google key is configured, so the OpenStreetMap base map is used.
visitor.map.googleFailed: The Google base map could not be loaded. Reload the page to fall back to OpenStreetMap.
visitor.village.label: Village
visitor.municipality.label: Municipality
visitor.village.unverifiedHelp: The public sources for this village could not be confirmed in this build, so nothing about it is presented as verified.
visitor.badge.approximateHelp: The position is approximate until it is surveyed on the ground: it finds the area, not the doorstep.
visitor.badge.sampleHelp: Sample data created for the prototype. This provider is not a real business and cannot be contacted.
visitor.detail.partial: Some details could not be loaded ({message}); what you see comes from the map data.
visitor.directions.newTab: Both links open Google Maps navigation in a new tab.
visitor.directions.newTabShort: opens Google Maps in a new tab
visitor.directions.noCoords: No coordinates yet, so there is no navigation link.
visitor.visit.title: I'm here
visitor.visit.explain: Anonymous: it records a point, never a person. The position is sent without a name, and it is only ever shown aggregated — a cell reaches the dashboard only once at least five different devices have been counted in it.
visitor.listing.confirmedHelp: The host entered and confirmed these facts. A model never fills them in.
visitor.request.title: Send a request to {title}
visitor.request.noBooking: This is not a booking and not a payment. A request is only a message: nothing is reserved and nothing is charged.
visitor.request.messagePlaceholder: For example: two of us would like to walk on Saturday morning — is that possible?
visitor.request.privacy: No name, no e-mail, no phone number. The request is tied only to the anonymous session of this browser, and the host answers here.
visitor.request.sentHelp: Sent. The host sees the message and answers here — still no booking and no payment.
visitor.request.mineHelp: Requests sent from this browser. Clearing the browser storage ends this list.
visitor.request.mineEmpty: No request from this browser yet.
visitor.request.statusHelp.sent: Waiting for the host to answer.
visitor.request.statusHelp.confirmed: The host said yes. Nothing is reserved and nothing is paid — agree the details in the messages.
visitor.request.statusHelp.completed: The host marked this one as done.
visitor.request.statusHelp.cancelled: Cancelled, by you or by the host.
visitor.request.statusHelp.refused: The host cannot take this one.
visitor.request.statusHelp.expired: Nobody answered before the request expired.
visitor.explore.title: Explore
visitor.explore.lead: The list is the text alternative of the map: the same items, in the same order, under the same filters.
visitor.explore.searchPlaceholder: A name, or a word from the summary
visitor.explore.selectHint: Choose an item in the list or on the map to see the details, how to get there and — for a provider — how to send a request.
visitor.geo.asking: Asking the browser for your position…
visitor.geo.denied: The browser refused the position. Everything else works without it.
visitor.geo.error: The position could not be read.
visitor.geo.privacy: Your position stays in this browser. It is sent only when you press “I'm here” or ask for a day plan from where you stand — always without a name.
visitor.trails.title: Trails
visitor.trails.lead: Approved segments with their latest condition report. Choose a trail and its GPX track is drawn on the map.
visitor.trails.selectHint: Choose a trail to see its track, its latest condition report and the report form.
visitor.trails.gpxReady: The GPX track is drawn on the map.
visitor.trails.gpxEmpty: This segment has no GPX track yet.
visitor.trails.gpxFailed: The GPX track could not be loaded.
visitor.trails.gpxAnnounce: The track of {trail} is drawn on the map.
visitor.trails.reportHelp: Your report is stored as a draft: it reaches the map only after a validator has approved it.
visitor.trails.notePlaceholder: For example: a fallen tree across the path after the second bend.
visitor.trails.pickOnMap: Pick the point on the map
visitor.trails.pickHint: Click or tap the map to set the point of your report.
visitor.trails.sentHelp: Thank you. The report is stored as a draft and appears only once a validator has approved it.
visitor.ask.title: Ask about Vrmac
visitor.ask.lead: Ask in your own words about the villages, the places and the traditions of Vrmac.
visitor.ask.rule: The answer comes only from approved entries and always carries its source. When no validated source covers the question, the assistant says so instead of inventing an answer.
visitor.ask.question: Your question
visitor.ask.questionPlaceholder: For example: which church stands in Gornja Lastva?
visitor.ask.empty: No question yet. The answers appear here, the newest first.
visitor.ask.grounded: Every sentence above comes from the approved entries cited below.
visitor.ask.refusedFallback: No validated source covers this question.
visitor.ask.refusedExplain: No validated source covers this question, so the assistant does not answer. Nothing is invented, and the refusal is recorded.
visitor.ask.pausedExplain: The monthly budget for the assistant is reached. Until it resets, only previously checked answers are available — no new text is generated.
visitor.ask.reason.low_confidence: The approved sources are too far from the question.
visitor.ask.reason.no_approved_source: No approved entry covers this question.
visitor.ask.reason.llm_declined: The model declined to answer from these sources.
visitor.ask.reason.unsupported_answer: Nothing was left after the support check.
visitor.ask.reason.assistant_paused: The assistant is paused for this month.
visitor.ask.dropped: The automatic support check removed sentences that no approved source carried (removed: {count}).
visitor.ask.supportHelp: Every candidate sentence is checked against the cited passages. Unsupported sentences are dropped before the answer reaches you.
visitor.ask.noCitations: No source is attached to this answer.
visitor.ask.cache: previously checked answer, served from the cache
visitor.ask.answeredAnnounce: The answer is ready, with its sources.
visitor.ask.refusedAnnounce: No answer: no validated source covers this question.
visitor.itinerary.title: Plan a day
visitor.itinerary.lead: A walking plan across the villages, built only from approved places and providers. Distances and times are estimates over approximate coordinates.
visitor.itinerary.villagesHint: Nothing ticked means every village. A plan may cross the ridge and the municipal boundary between Tivat and Kotor.
visitor.itinerary.startHereHelp: Without a position the plan starts from the trailhead in Donja Lastva.
visitor.itinerary.clear: Clear the route from the map
visitor.itinerary.totals: {stops} stops · about {km} km · about {hours} h of walking and visiting
visitor.itinerary.multiVillageHelp: The plan ignores village boundaries: the nearest next stop may lie in another village, on the other side of the ridge, in Tivat or in Kotor.
visitor.itinerary.noStops: Nothing fits these hours and interests yet.
visitor.itinerary.doneAnnounce: The day plan is ready. Stops: {count}.
visitor.calendar.title: Heritage calendar
visitor.calendar.lead: Approved entries of the kind “event”, with their date and their source.
visitor.calendar.notOnMap: This entry has no coordinates on the map yet.
